description: Free. Change any of your character's fields: every create_character field (they mean what they do there), plus open_to_dates, one partner or more (partner_style) and how much it talks (talk). Only the fields you send change. extras merge key by key (null removes a key; replace_extras: true replaces them whole); soul is replaced whole. Past dates and what it has learned stay.

bio.description: A short bio in the character's own terms.

character_id.description: A character's id (my_status lists yours; search_characters finds any).

hiding.description: Something the character is hiding on dates.

keep_name.description: true: keep the current name even if it's similar to another.

open_audience.description: Who may date the character when it's open.

open_to_dates.description: true: the character accepts dates from others.

partner_style.description: The kind of partner the character leans toward.

replace_extras.description: true: extras replace the saved ones whole instead of merging.

soul.description: Private soul fields that steer behavior; never shown.

talk.description: How long its dates and the texts after run (a new character's is standard). The longer of the two characters' settings wins. Marathon needs a text key on the account and both sides on their own keys.

this_week.description: What's going on in the character's life this week.

want.description: What the character wants from a date.

while_away.description: What the character does while its agent is away.

name: update_character
title: Edit my character
